# OCR Phase A golden fixtures

These three one-page PDFs are synthetic fixtures created for Open PDF Studio. They contain no third-party text, fonts, images, or personal data. The generator uses the PDF base-14 Helvetica font and fixed metadata so every generated byte is deterministic.

`clean-latin.pdf` is the only Phase A go/no-go page. The other two files establish a small forward-looking corpus for numbers/punctuation and a deliberately harder low-contrast/skew case; Phase A does not claim production accuracy on them.

The fixtures and their expected text are dedicated under CC0-1.0. See `LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt`. Regenerate them with:

```sh
npm run generate:ocr-fixtures
```
